c.title: $3,500 / 2br - Kitsilano - Fireplace - TOP FLOOR - Character - Modern - Yard- Laundry (vancouver west, ubc, kitsilano, pt grey, point grey)
c.description:
- LOCATION LOCATION! LOCATION! Situated in the heart of Kitsilano at Balsam and West 4th Avenue.

- TOP FLOOR ne corner.

- Big balcony.

- Tastefully renovated with newer kitchen, bathroom, lighting, stone counters, tub, toilet, sinks, double-glazed windows throughout; beautifully done.

- WOW - heated bathroom floors!

- Step out your door, walk steps to shops, cafes, restaurants, groceries, Lululemon, Arcteryx, Whole Foods, banks, yoga, fitness ... and so much more.

- Walk only 5 minutes down the hill to Kits. Pool and beach! Or, walk to Granville Island, tennis courts, parks, playground ... so much to do!

- Private INSUITE LAUNDRY.

- Cozy gas FIREPLACE.

- High ceilings.

- Beautiful character - gorgeous refinished fir floors, wood mantle with shelving.

- TONS OF NATURAL LIGHT; windows in every room!

- COMPLETE and GORGEOUS RENOVATION. BATHROOM - new tub, toilet, quartz counters, under-mount sink, vanity cabinet, faucet, floor tiles and lighting. KITCHEN - cabinets, granite counters, under-mount sink, tile floors and STAINLESS STEEL appliances (fridge, stove, DISHWASHER, hood-fan).

- Corner suite.

- There is also a shared yard which is rarely used.

- NO SMOKING!!!

- Some pets welcome with permission.

- If interested and if you like, please reply as "top floor fireplace" and tell a bit about you (ie. where moving from and working, how long at both, any pets, when available to view, etc.).
